scope: Frontend engineering only. No force labels, force model, reserved data, or physical deployment.
freeze_policy: Written before candidate implementation or synthetic evaluation. Do not change acceptance or settings after observations. Preserve all failures. Select once using dev; evaluate selected candidate once on heldout.
source_reuse: sealed_baseline is a byte copy of offline_uv_contact_20261022/frontend required files and vendor; E1/E2 state and encoders unchanged

float_iclk.sampling: scipy order3 spline at float64 coordinates
float_iclk.seed: fixed-reference DIS ultrafast, finestScale2; refinement absolute reference-current, never temporal
float_iclk.photometric: local weighted least-squares gain and offset; never normalize UV amplitudes

pyr_lk.sampling: OpenCV pyramidal Lucas-Kanade, uint8 image observations and float32 point outputs

options.old_dis: symptom baseline, same old pairwise DIS parameters; not selectable

synthetic.generator: independent continuous Fourier texture: 64 random frequencies 0.025..0.14 cycles/px, random phases; analytical intensity evaluated at inverse-warp points; uint8 quantization only at simulated camera output
synthetic.evaluation_mask: fixed geometry grid points with x in [50,590], y in [45,435]; no validity-conditioned frame/point deletion for primary errors

acceptance.raw_corrected_identity: bit exact when independent correction absent
acceptance.reference_quality_geometry_negatives: reuse and rerun sealed analytic suite; strict reference causal binding remains

selection: Candidates satisfying every dev translation, spatial, photometric and invalidity requirement preferred; if none pass select diagnostic winner by max translation component error ratio then median spatial error, but gate FAIL. Among passes choose fastest measured total matching time. Freeze selection/code hashes before heldout. No heldout retry or threshold adjustment.

real_smoke.scope: training-source images only, no labels; after selection freeze
real_smoke.reference: original hand reference_frame.jpg and stage point0 before_contact; UNVERIFIED_REFERENCE matching diagnostic, no force tensor/training eligibility
real_smoke.purpose: finite, validity, latency, ordered causal matching only; no physical accuracy claims or tuning

readiness: Engineering synthetic gate is distinct from real reference/calibration, SDK parity and physical-force qualification. Passing engineering does not authorize training whose data gate is unresolved.
